title: sprint-start from a host session takes the single-writer lease, so the next prusik drive always escalates writer_busy
detail: 2026-11-19: ran prusik gate sprint-start observed-writes inside a Claude session (as the hand-off prescribes), then the operator ran prusik drive from a plain shell. Drive escalated writer_busy: the host session e238baa5 held the lease. The operator had to run prusik gate release-writer by hand (the session's own attempt was denied by the auto-mode classifier). Expected: the documented sprint-start -> drive hand-off works without a manual lease release, e.g. sprint-start (or drive's hand-off) releases or transfers the host's lease to drive. Related: fb-702c70a3971f.
